detailed_descriptions_html.en:
It’s About Pirates is a survivors-like where you blast through relentless waves of enemies, collect loot, and upgrade your ship for epic naval battles. Navigate through storms of cannonballs, face mythical sea monsters, and time your attacks for devastating impact.

Transform your ship into an unstoppable fortress with flamethrowers, harpoons, mortars, and a vast arsenal of deadly upgrades. Strategically combine weapons and items to craft powerful builds. Be prepared, as increasingly challenging enemies will stand in your way.

Customize your vessel with over 150 unique parts discovered throughout your adventures. Complete quests across different pirate realms to expand your collection of ship components.

Features:

  • ⚔️ Automatic or manual aiming

  • 🧭 Sail through 30 adventures

  • ⚓ 10 distinct captains

  • 🏴‍☠️ 6 Factions with unique abilities

  • 🗡️ Over 140 items to shape your build

  • 💰 Collect loot and unlock new ship skins

  • ☠️ Test your skill in Endless mode

  • 🏆 Compete on the leaderboard and claim your place among the top pirates

The sea awaits!
